fit_scope: within previously sampled geographic groups; individually held-out allelic copies conditional on retained SNPs
source_processing: old-only historical loci removed in original paper; historical allele loss cannot be reconstructed
test_design: same SNPs for region and pooled species; every region >=75% call rate; >95% within-region genotype identity over >=60 shared called SNPs removed from BOTH training models
limitations: near-identical genotypes do not prove kinship or technical duplicates
removal of similar training genotypes leaves a selected evaluable subset, especially Linaria
source populations and sequencing batch cannot be experimentally separated
not an unseen-region prediction, whole-genome result, or intervention/fitness model
SNPs and same-study species are not independent biological replications
